shortDescription: This module manages volume mapping on IBM Storage Virtualize family systems

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP or Partition IP of the Storage Virtualize system.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain for the Storage Virtualize system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(clustername).

options.name: host
options.description: Specifies the host name or UUID for host mapping. This parameter is required to create or delete a volume-to-host mapping.

options.name: hostcluster
options.description: Specifies the name or UUID of the host cluster for host mapping. This parameter is required to create or delete a volume-to-hostcluster mapping.

options.name: password
options.description: REST API password for the Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: scsi
options.description: Specifies the SCSI logical unit number (LUN) ID to assign to a volume on the specified host or host cluster. Applies when I(state=present).

options.name: state
options.description: Creates (C(present)) or removes (C(absent)) a volume mapping.

options.name: token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the Storage Virtualize system. To generate a token, use the ibm_svc_auth module.

options.name: username
options.description: REST API username for the Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: volname
options.description: Specifies the volume name or UID for host or hostcluster mapping.
